articles.summary: Sensata’s new electrostatic particulate matter (ePM) sensor supports real-time detection of particulate matter to enable OEMs to address evolving emissions monitoring requirements. Designed to detect particulate matter concentrations as low as 10 mg/mi and support more stringent onboard diagnostics (OBD) thresholds. Combines high-accuracy electrostatic measurement, continuous monitoring capability and tamper-resistant design to support OEM emissions compliance strategies. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST), today introduced its ePM electrostatic particulate matter sensor, a real-time particulate matter monitoring solution designed to enable automotive and commercial vehicle OEMs to address increasingly stringent emissions monitoring requirements. Using high-accuracy electrostatic sensing, the ePM sensor is designed to detect particulate matter concentrations in diesel exhaust systems and support faster monitoring response for onboard diagnostics and emissions compliance applications. articles.summary: Sensata's Brake Force sensor directly measures clamping force within the brake caliper, providing the real-time feedback required for precise electromechanical brake (EMB) control. Supports improved braking performance, consistency, and safety through high-accuracy force measurement and closed-loop control at each wheel. Enables OEMs to accelerate adoption of brake-by-wire architectures designed for electrification, software-defined vehicles, and advanced driver assistance systems. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST), today announced its brake force sensors are now enabling electromechanical braking (EMB) systems in leading electric vehicles. This milestone marks a significant step in the transition from traditional hydraulic braking to fully electric, brake-by-wire systems, as vehicle OEMs increasingly adopt architectures designed for electrification, autonomy, and software-defined control. articles.summary: FL Series uses ultrasonic technology to deliver highly accurate, non-intrusive flow monitoring for data center liquid cooling systems. Designed for data center liquid cooling applications, the FL Series provides continuous visibility into coolant flow to support effective thermal management and system performance. An IP65-rated, non-intrusive design, low pressure drops and no moving parts support reliable, low-maintenance operation. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST) today announced the launch of its FL Series Ultrasonic Flow Sensors, a non-intrusive flow-monitoring solution for liquid cooling systems in data centers and other industrial applications. Supporting flow rates up to 400 liters per minute, the FL Series provides visibility into coolant flow to help operators identify potential issues and protect the uptime of critical computing infrastructure. Sensata will then host an earnings release conference call and webcast at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss the results and business performance. articles.summary: Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST) today announced that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend in the amount of $0.12 per share. The Company will pay this fourth quarter 2026 dividend on November 25, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 11, 2026. About Sensata Technologies Sensata Technologies is a global industrial technology company striving to create a safer, cleaner, more efficient and electrified world. Through its broad portfolio of mission-critical sensors, electrical protection components and sensor-rich solutions, Sensata helps its customers address increasingly complex engineering and operating performance requirements. With more than 16,000 employees and global operations in 13 countries, Sensata serves customers in the automotive, industrial, and aerospace, defense and commercial equipment markets. Learn more at www.sensata.com and follow Sensata on LinkedIn , Facebook , X and Instagram . Media Investor Contact: James Entwistle <br
